reviews.text: FlyFix is fantastic! I cannot recommend them highly enough. Jose was so professional and truly a perfectionist.  Daniel’s communication was spot on.  We had sun shades installed in our courtyard on a very hot day and he did an awesome job. We will definitely be using FlyFix again soon.
reviews.author: maggie moore

reviews.text: I wish I went to them first before someone on Task Rabbit who had no clue what he was doing. I could not believe when I called on a Sunday that they asked if I was looking to have work done the same day. I had it done next day, but that type of response time will have me coming back. The workers also did a great job with my tiles.
reviews.author: A G

reviews.text: Quick turnaround, immediate estimate, reasonable prices and constant communication. They were professional, quick, and efficient. Would 100% recommend!
reviews.author: Justin Jay Jones

reviews.text: We undertook a project to re-build a shed that was too short to stand in. We had a Tuff Shed 8x 8 x 5 high. I don't know why I bought a shed too short to stand up in. I had many quotes to move it, tear it down, rebuild it totally, and more. My wife wanted it saved, so José said he could move and raise it up, even expanding it. The quote was very reasonable, and he did exactly as he said. The work is beautiful, and I can stand up to move things now. It makes the shed very usable now, where before it was just a pain to put material in and remove it.
reviews.author: Mahlon Tate

reviews.text: I was nervous about how this wallpaper would turn out but it’s perfect and couldn’t look better! They were very responsive,  efficient and have great customer service. FlyFix is the best and I would definitely recommend them for any of your house projects!!
reviews.author: Lindsey George

reviews.text:
The workers were all experienced and courteous. Samuel, Ricardo, and Alfredo and their crews were very good and easy to work with.
Daniel the coordinator was very good at his job and kept us informed as the job progressed.
Thanks
Jay Stephens
Lago Vista  Hoa
reviews.author: J Stephens

reviews.text: Jose did a great job! He is obviously very experienced and was able to mount our TV, put up a large shelf, and change out a ceiling fan on the same day we made our request! Flyfix was very responsive and communicative throughout the whole process! We are very satisfied!
reviews.author: Hillary Blake

reviews.text:
I used FlyFix for two projects that I’ve been anxious to get done for a long time.  The first was to removed carpet and put in a new wood floor.   This was done very much to my satisfaction.  Wonderful work.
The second project was to build bookshelves in my library.  This was also done really well.  The work on both projects was so professionally done and in a timely manner.  The workers of both projects were friendly and accommodating to my schedule.  I would enthusiastically endorse FlyFix and the people they provided to me.
reviews.author: Dan B

reviews.text: Choosing FlyFix for my home remodeling was the best decision I made as a first time home buyer! From start to finish, their team was professional, courteous, and attentive to my all my requests. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations.
reviews.author: Jorge Bazoberry

reviews.text: We had the most wonderful experience using FlyFix. They are so easy to get a hold of, they respond fast and are very flexible with availability and very reasonably priced. We moved into our new house and had a handful of random items that needed to fixed, hung, and put together. It was such a weight off our shoulders with everything else going on. They even installed our doggy door through our wall which is magical. Thank you very much Jose and FlyFix!!!
reviews.author: Falan Sample

reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! Jose is the BEST!! Seriously. I reached out to 10 different referrals and they had the best communication and price. The communication was great and seriously - Jose was wonderful!!!! Like went above and beyond! Thank you!
reviews.author: Morgan Heinrich

reviews.text: Thank you to Flyfix and Jose and team! They are absolutely amazing! The work they did was 100% top notch! The communication, cost, scheduling, professionalism and overall work was perfect! It was such a pleasure to work with them. I will definitely use them for all my house handyman needs!
reviews.author: LB Adams

reviews.text:
Flyfix was contracted by my property management company, so I cannot evaluate their pricing, however I was impressed with their immediacy in contacting me. A side note with that was they texted me! That was great because I don’t answer unknown numbers.
They showed when they said they would. Kept me informed throughout the process. Which was new and great since they were also dealing with my property management company.
Every issue was fixed and better than when I moved in within a week.
Thank you Emily and Aaron!
reviews.author: Heather Fowler

reviews.text: FlyFix is truly an exceptional company. They provide great quality services at very low prices. My experience could not have been better. They were responsive, professional, and completed all of the work in a timely manner with excellent quality. I will be using FlyFix in the future for any future home repairs!
reviews.author: james Chilcoat

reviews.text: I called Flyfix to install 2 patio fans and couple of dimmer switches. I got a great quote and an appointment the next morning. We are extremely happy with the clean professional work. Highly recommend Flyfix.
reviews.author: Randy Aldridge

reviews.text: The guys did a great job. Definitely on speed dial if I ever need anything!
reviews.author: Bupe Chinukwe

reviews.text: I’ve used FlyFix for multiple projects. Everything about them was perfect. They came when they were supposed too, prices were good, work was excellent, and they were friendly. Great professionalism and expertise.
reviews.author: Britney Cole

reviews.text: Needed someone to come out quickly to get the yard cleaned up, the two gentlemen that came out were super quick and efficient and left my yard looking beautiful! I even threw in an extra $50 because of how amazed I was, they came out rain or shine and made my yard look amazing, cleaned up my edges, picked up the yard trimmings that they made, Would definitely recommend
reviews.author: Heaven Jackson

reviews.text:
When I was looking for a handyman to do sheetrock repair work in my kitchen I received several estimates. Needless to say most of the estimates were budget busters. Except for one: Flyfix.
While working Emily she made the entire process an enjoyable experience. Flyfix sheetrock techs were competent, efficient and professional.
Flyfix is a family - owned company who take pride in their.
reviews.author: ROBERT Damora

reviews.text:
These guys did a fantastic job. They were very reasonable and quick on installing replacement tiles for our extra bathroom.
We will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: SM M

reviews.text: I was referred by a friend to use FlyFix and so glad I did! I had a hole in my wall (that was textured) and Jose came within the same week I had the issue and fixed the problem. It looked better than before! I always recommend FlyFix to any family and friends that need a handy service!
reviews.author: TM123

reviews.text:
Pumbing Repair.       My toilet had been all the Fritz for 5 months.  After I realized how long it had been I called this terrific plumber F fly fixed.    My  Daughter from another  Skate, Had did the research and told me to give them a call. I am so glad she did.  Because I was at a total loss as to who to call.

They came out right away. And made repairs.  You would not believe how thankful it was.

Fast, Inefficient. Thank you Fly Fix..
And I notice they have other things that they are able to do, I for one,   Will be calling them back. for future projects.        A happy customer.  !
reviews.author: Ramona Rain

reviews.text: I’ve used Flyfix multiple times and will continue to do so. Great people to work with. Friendly folks, good quality work, easy to book, good communication, on time, honest work and fair prices. Flyfix never cuts corners like many competitors. 5 stars highly recommend
reviews.author: DJ Taylor

reviews.text: Needed some electric work and George was great! He was on time, polite and friendly and did a great job! Would recommend FlyFix for other projects and needs.
reviews.author: Chris Hakemack

reviews.text: Daniel and the crew were very professional, quick and fair priced. Usually you have to settle for 2 out of the 3, not with Fly Fix. I highly recommend them and their services. They will be my first call for any repair moving forward.
reviews.author: Dameon Scherf

reviews.text: I am really happy I found FlyFix!  I worked with Daniel who was very nice, very responsive and they were very fairly priced for the scope of work.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Joanne Giovanniello

reviews.text: Everything has been top notch. Jose is an amazing worker and the other guys dare also good. When the deck is finished I’ll share photos.
reviews.author: Jack Hartsfield

reviews.text: Fly fix is amazing! Locally owned and operated great customer service and were easy to deal with super attentive and answered all my questions, recommend for any residential and commercial needs! 10/10
reviews.author: Venancio Coronado

reviews.text: One stop shop for any of your home project needs! I’ve used fly fix a couple of times now and have had nothing but great experiences. Highly recommend them as they do some quality work at a very reasonable cost!
reviews.author: Andrej Bradas

reviews.text: The team at fly fix did a great job remodeling and painting my kitchen. Jose was responsive and got the job done right on schedule.
reviews.author: Мike Didier

reviews.text: Great service! Goes above and beyond! Finds ways to get it done and figures it out. Extremely honest and dependable! Highly recommend them for any of your home needs!
reviews.author: Hien Tran

reviews.text: Great company that helped me out greatly with my home. Awesome customer service and great quality work. Prices were very reasonable. Thanks for helping me out!!!
reviews.author: ben nus

reviews.text: Job was completed in a timely manner and with a quality that I was very pleased with.  I received a follow up to ensure that the work was done properly and functioning correctly. Would use again.
reviews.author: Andrew Essary

reviews.text: I couldn’t ask for better and speedy service at our place of business! The employee that did the work was so friendly and helpful! Will definitely keep them in my contacts!
reviews.author: Vicki Markham

reviews.text: FlyFix Installed Flooring in our home. They did a great job. I would use FlyFix for future projects.
